confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge of Mexico City price levels for July 2026. No live booking pages or current listings were checked. Restaurant and hostel anchors are more reliable than hotel and cocktail/wine anchors. Hotel 3-star and 1-star rates vary widely by neighborhood and season. Cocktail and wine are set relative to beer, since direct knowledge is weaker. FX: the 0.6955 figure was reported in search results attributed to the RBA exchange rates overview page for 15 October 2026 at 4pm; the F11 table itself was not opened, and an RBA homepage figure for 14 October (0.7002) differed, so the 15 October observation should be verified against the official table.
comparable_city_reasoning: Regional basis: mid-priced Latin American capitals with strong tourism demand (for example Bogotá and Santiago-tier pricing for restaurants and hotels), adjusted for Mexico City's peso-based price levels. Budget restaurant and hostel prices are set at the low end of that range.
